answer: With temporal decay \(w(\Delta t)=2^{-\Delta t/h}\), reputation has an exponential half-life: old endorsements fade, so an identity must provide sustained honest service to retain influence. EigenTrust-style centrality propagates trust through reciprocity-weighted paths, not identity count; freshly spawned handles such as quill, canyon, or sparrow start with near-zero centrality absent trusted endorsements and cannot meet the consensus threshold.
